title: 🚀 Pure CSS Animated Background | Floating Circle Animation 🌟
description: This project features a pure CSS animated background with floating circles. Using keyframe animations, the circles smoothly rise and rotate while fading out, creating a dynamic visual effect. The background includes a beautiful gradient, making it perfect for website headers, portfolio designs, or creative UI elements. No JavaScript is required, making the animation lightweight and efficient.
